QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Scrounging for Mesos
QuestInfo.0: What does #b#p2153000##k have to say? Go find out.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2153000#, one of the Black Wing managers, says he'll sell you his #b#t1003134##k. With his hat, the gatekeepers will surely let you in. All you have to do is give him the dough--#b100,000 Mesos#k, to be specific.

#b100,000 Mesos#k
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t1003134#. #p2153000#, laughing, said he'll sell you another if you ever need it. He really is an unpleasant man, but at least you can enter the mine now.

0.0: That'll cost you #b100,000 Mesos#k. It's really not that expensive...although I got it for free...
0.1: It's not like any of the bosses check on this kind of thing. Besides, money is the most important thing in this world. I've got to make some somehow...

yes.0: Talk to me again when you have the money. I'll be waiting.

1.0: Have you got the 100,000 Mesos? Good, good. Here's the hat then. Talk to me again later.

default.0: What?? You don't have the #b100,000 Mesos#k yet? Geez, I picked the wrong customer. Don't you want to enter the mine?
